response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS overall FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_h, ov.overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN ov WHERE p.avg_h > ov.overall), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS kept_mean FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_h AS avg_humidity, k.avg_h - k.overall AS excess_over_overall_avg, k.avg_h - km.kept_mean AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN km WHERE k.overall IS NOT NULL AND km.kept_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (k.avg_h - km.kept_mean) IS NULL, (k.avg_h - km.kept_mean) DESC, k.equipref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the mean of the per-equipment average humidities (each equipment weighted equally). It is not the mean of all raw readings. Equipment with only NULL humidity has a NULL average and is left out of that mean.
The difference from the kept mean is signed (equipment average minus kept-equipment mean). The excess over the overall average is likewise average minus overall average.
Ties at 10th place are broken by equipref, which is an arbitrary but deterministic choice.
